newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Dell cuts network server prices in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Dell cuts network server prices in Asia.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said on Tuesday it has cut the list prices of its entire line of Pentium PowerEdge network servers by nine percent in the Asia-Pacific region.
The company said in a statement the move was a result of Dell's "ability to quickly pass on to customers the lower costs of components such as memory and processors."
The move is the latest in a series of price cuts this year, including a cut of between 22 percent and 41 percent on its Pentium-based PowerEdge line in the United States.
